concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-customer-delete-node]] - Node.js customer deletion by customer ID, with cascading deletion of all associated payment methods and cancellation of all associated recurring billing subscriptions
warnings: Keep the destructive effects explicit: the page states that deleting a customer also deletes every associated payment method and cancels every associated recurring billing subscription.

Do not import immediate timing, refunds, proration, paid-day forfeiture, recovery, response semantics, or other consequences from the separate payment-method deletion endpoint or neighboring references.
Keep the route scoped to the Node.js customer-delete operation identified by customer ID; do not generalize it to other SDK languages or deletion objects.
